response.sql:
WITH playlist_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.PlaylistId,
    COUNT(pt.TrackId) as track_count
  FROM Playlist p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(track_count) as avg_count
  FROM playlist_counts
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.PlaylistId,
    pc.track_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN ac.avg_count = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE pc.track_count / ac.avg_count
    END as ratio
  FROM playlist_counts pc
  CROSS JOIN average_count ac
)
SELECT 
  PlaylistId,
  track_count,
  ratio
FROM with_ratios
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: If the average track count is 0 (edge case where all playlists have 0 tracks), division by zero produces NULL, treated as a 'missing' ratio and sorted last.
